weaknesses.name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs purely deterministic integer scroll and tile arithmetic and declares no rand capability

weaknesses.name: Use of Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
weaknesses.reason: pure graphics transform: package implements tilemap scrolling, culling, tile-attribute collision queries and scanline rendering only, no cipher, hash or MAC [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are bounded tile ids, palette bank indices, scroll offsets and buffer lengths [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]
